module.title: Network related checks
module.description: Network related checks such as check_ping, check_tcp, check_dns, check_http, check_connections and check_ntp_offset.
module.name: CheckNet

commands.check_ping: Ping another host and check the result.

check_tcp.description: Connect to a TCP port and optionally send/expect data to check that a service is reachable.

check_ssh.description: Connect to an SSH port and verify the server presents a valid SSH banner.

check_dns.description: Resolve a host name and check the response time and resulting addresses.

check_http.description: Send an HTTP/HTTPS request and check the response status, time, size and body.

check_nsclient_web_online.description: Query the REST API of a remote NSClient++ agent (reachability or a remote check).

check_apache_status.description: Check an Apache httpd server via its mod_status page (server-status?auto).

check_nginx_status.description: Check an NGINX server via its stub_status page.

check_phpfpm_status.description: Check a PHP-FPM pool via its status page.

check_tomcat_status.description: Check an Apache Tomcat server via the manager status page (XML).

check_connections.description: Count active TCP/UDP connections and report counts per protocol and TCP state.

check_ntp_offset.description: Query an NTP server and check the offset between the local clock and the server.
